title: Leadline Use Receipt
description: The execution result for one contract step. A step advances ONLY when satisfied=true. Invocation alone never satisfies — that is the anti-gate-gaming guarantee. Separate from the contract (obligation vs result).

relevant.description: Result references at least one of the step's satisfaction.requires_relevance_to tokens.

satisfied.description: AND of the step's satisfaction criteria. The ONLY signal that advances the contract or feeds learning.

failure.description: Why the step did not satisfy (none = satisfied).
